sota_papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
sota_papers.key_finding: RNN + Monte Carlo Dropout: team-level metrics + rolling-form + spatial shot-chart embeddings. Calibrated sequential probabilities. Achieves sub-0.21 Brier on 2024 NBA.
sota_papers.actionable: Port shot-chart embeddings as feature category. Add MC Dropout calibration post-processing to island predictions.

sota_papers.title: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis
sota_papers.key_finding: Stacking: Naïve Bayes + AdaBoost + MLP + KNN + XGBoost + Decision Tree + Logistic Regression. Superior to any single model.
sota_papers.actionable: Island S22 already uses CatBoost. Consider adding AdaBoost to crossover pool as CPU-friendly alternative.

sota_papers.title: Forecasting NCAA Basketball with LSTM vs Transformer (Brier loss)
sota_papers.key_finding: LSTM + Brier loss achieves Brier 0.1589 (NCAA). Transformer has higher AUC (0.8473) but worse calibration. Brier-loss training objective directly improves Brier score.
sota_papers.actionable: Current islands optimize Brier as objective — validated. LSTM architecture not feasible on CPU-only islands. Calibration post-processing (isotonic/Platt) applicable.

proposals.title: Add shot-chart spatial zones as feature category
proposals.description: Add 7-zone shot efficiency features (paint/mid/corner3/above-break3 × FG% + attempt rate) to engine.py. These appear in MDPI 2026 as top predictors. Can be sourced from NBA stats API or boxscore data already in cache.

proposals.title: Brier-loss training objective already confirmed optimal
proposals.description: LSTM paper confirms Brier-loss training > cross-entropy for calibration. Our islands already optimize Brier directly. No change needed — current approach validated by SOTA.

proposals.title: AdaBoost to island crossover pool
proposals.description: Add sklearn AdaBoostClassifier to the model_type rotation pool in evolution islands. Stacked ensemble paper shows AdaBoost contributes meaningfully when stacked. CPU-feasible. Implement in mutate() as new model option.

proposals.title: Port ELO momentum features to political engine
proposals.description: NBA SOTA top features are momentum/form (team_elo_5_y, home_next). Analogues for political: legislator_approval_rolling_10event, party_momentum_kalshi_30d, entity_recent_brier_delta. Add to political engine.py feature categories. P7 logistic_regression success suggests momentum features already dominate — formalize them.

cross_project_insight: P7 logistic_regression achieves POL BEST 0.24924. SOTA literature confirms LR excels when momentum features dominate (P7 has 38085 gens of momentum-feature selection). Same principle: NBA islands should verify which feature categories drive S13 extra_trees gen-1 success.
